title: Disney+, Hulu Raise Monthly Pricing on Streaming Plans in U.S. Again
content: The updated prices apply to new subscriptions as of Wednesday. Current subscribers will get a price change on or after October 21. The streamer previously raised its prices in October 2025, and before that raised its price in October 2024.

title: Global Stage Hollywood Screens World Premiere of Psyren TV Anime's 2nd Episode on October 3 With Original Creator Toshiaki Iwashiro
content: The anime will debut on Tokyo MX and BS11 on October 4 at 11:00 p.m., before airing later that evening on Sun TV . Crunchyroll will stream the anime worldwide excluding Japan and China. The anime stars: • Rikuya Yasuda as Ageha Yoshin • Mayuko Kazama as Sakurako Amamiya.

title: Marvelous Announces Story of Seasons: Your Wonderful Life Virtual Reality Farming Game
content: Marvelous announced on Thursday Story of Seasons: Your Wonderful Life , a virtual reality game based on its Story of Seasons: A Wonderful Life/ farming life sim. Marvelous and Grounding will release the game for Meta VR Glasses, Meta Quest 3, and Meta Quest 3s in spring 2027.
author: ANN

title: Sekiro: No Defeat Anime Airs in January as 8-Episode TV Series
content: The staff of Sekiro: No Defeat , the new anime based on FromSoftware 's Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice game, announced on Friday that the anime film will air on television in January in an episodic format. The anime will have eight episodes, and will feature new content reconstructing the film into a television series.
author: ANN

title: Norimitsu Kaihō, Kurageso's Akarui Mirai Manga Ends in Next Chapter
content: Houbunsha 's Manga Time Kirara Forward magazine announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Thursday that Norimitsu Kaihō and Kurageso's Akarui Mirai manga will end in the next issue on October 23. Kaihō and Kurageso launched the series in Houbunsha 's Manga Time Kirara Forward magazine in August 2025.
